age.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice (4-6 weeks old; Japan SLC, Shizuoka, Japan)

sex.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice (4-6 weeks old; Japan SLC, Shizuoka, Japan) and male ICR mice (8-20 weeks old; Japan SLC) were used in the present study.

dosing.evidence: Mice were intraperitoneally administered psilocin at 1.5 mg/kg 1 day before the onset of social defeat stress or immediately after the last stress exposure.
Volinanserin (Voli: 1.0 mg/kg) was administered intraperitoneally 30 min before psilocin administration.

group_housing.evidence: Only aggressor ICR mice housing stated: 'Male ICR mice (8 weeks old) were individually housed in plastic cages'; housing of experimental C57BL/6J mice not stated.

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on from 07:00 to 19:00)

assays.assay_description: Cubic open-field arena (45 × 45 × 45 cm) with a transparent plastic cage against one wall. 30-min no-target session followed 1 min later by a 10-min target session with a novel ICR mouse inside the cage. Time in interaction and corner zones (EthoVision XT), SI ratio and corner zone ratio. Psilocin (1.5 mg/kg i.p.) given 1 day before CSDS onset or immediately after CSDS completion; volinanserin (1.0 mg/kg i.p.) 30 min before psilocin in the post-CSDS experiment.

application_type.evidence: Mice were intraperitoneally administered psilocin at 1.5 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: No separate apparatus habituation described; the 30-min no-target session was recorded and analyzed.

setup_restrain.evidence: the C57BL/6J mouse was allowed to explore freely in the arena for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: Test performed in an open-field arena; no food described in the apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Test performed in an open-field arena; no water described in the apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocin administered 'immediately after the last stress exposure' (test ~24 h later) or '1 day before the onset of social defeat stress' (test ~11 days later); 'A social interaction test was conducted 1 day after the last stress exposure'.

sample_size.evidence: Figure 2: 'Values indicate the mean ± SEM (n = 9-13)', F(2,32) → 35 mice; Figure 3: '(n = 11-15)', F(3,47) → 51 mice

outcomes.summary: CSDS reduced interaction-zone time and SI ratio and increased corner-zone time/ratio. Psilocin (1.5 mg/kg) given before CSDS onset had no significant preventive effect, whereas psilocin given immediately after CSDS significantly improved the SI ratio, an effect blocked by the 5-HT2A antagonist volinanserin. Corner-zone measures were not significantly reversed by psilocin.
outcomes.statistics: Fig 2B target: F(2,32)=10.24, p=0.0004; Fig 2C SI ratio: F(2,32)=17.58, p<0.0001, CSDS vs CSDS+Psilocin p=0.1666; Fig 2D target: F(2,32)=10.24, p=0.0004, CSDS vs CSDS+Psilocin p=0.0239; Fig 2E: F(2,32)=4.156, p=0.025; Fig 3B target: F(3,47)=19.09, p<0.0001; Fig 3C SI ratio: F(3,47)=31.66, p<0.0001, CSDS vs CSDS+Psilocin p=0.0082, CSDS+Psilocin vs +Volinanserin p=0.0003; Fig 3D target: F(3,47)=27.83, p<0.0001; Fig 3E: F(3,47)=4.790, p=0.0054 (Bonferroni)
outcomes.evidence: The CSDS-induced decrease in the SI ratio was improved by psilocin administration; however, this psilocin effect was absent by volinanserin administration (Figure 3C: F (3,47) = 31.66, p < 0.0001).

B1_num_measures.evidence: the time spent in the interaction and corner zones was recorded and analyzed... A social interaction (SI) ratio and corner zone ratio were then calculated

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Zone times summed per session; no within-session time-course analysis reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or bout analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: time spent in the interaction and corner zones was recorded (zone occupancy is a spatial measure)

B5_social.evidence: a novel ICR mouse... was placed inside the transparent cage, and the C57BL/6J mouse was allowed to explore freely in the arena for 10 min

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate social approach/avoidance; no learning requirement during test.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: recorded and analyzed using EthoVision XT (Noldus, Wageningen, the Netherlands)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Data were analyzed using one-way ANOVA, followed by Bonferroni's post hoc test

E1_environment_type.evidence: The social interaction test was performed in a cubic open-field arena (45 × 45 × 45 cm; Science Shokai, Nagoya, Japan).

E2_shelter.evidence: Only a transparent stimulus cage in the arena; no shelter for the subject.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described; transparent cage is the stimulus enclosure.

E6_spatial.evidence: cubic open-field arena with virtually defined interaction and corner zones

E7_social_context.evidence: a novel ICR mouse... was placed inside the transparent cage

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: placed in the arena for 30 min in the absence of a target mouse (No-target session)... One minute later... for 10 min (Target session). During both sessions, the time spent... was recorded and analyzed

D2_session_duration.evidence: placed in the arena for 30 min in the absence of a target mouse

D3_recording_days.evidence: The social interaction test was conducted 1 day after the final CSDS session.

D4_baseline.evidence: Psilocin given before or immediately after CSDS; no behavioural recording before drug administration.

D5_followup.evidence: psilocin administered immediately after CSDS completion (or 1 day before CSDS onset); test conducted 1 day after the final CSDS session

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single Social Interaction Test; pre-CSDS and post-CSDS (± volinanserin) experiments collapsed into one assay.
B1 set to score 2 (4 measures) — gemma's score of 3 inconsistent with its own '4-6' value.
B4 set to 0 per rubric (zone occupancy is spatial, not ethological), overriding gemma.
D4 set to 0 (no pre-drug recording; no-target session occurs after drug) and D5 set to 1 (test ≥24 h post-dose) per modal qwen/deepseek.
Age set to adolescent (4-6 weeks) — candidates split three ways.
n_total derived from ANOVA df: F(2,32)→35 and F(3,47)→51, total 86; medium confidence.
Volinanserin included in dosing as an administered compound (antagonist), following deepseek.
